title: QMA hardness of continuum electronic energy with binary nuclear charges
exact_target: Is the ground-energy promise problem for the full antisymmetric continuum electronic Coulomb Hamiltonian QMA-hard under deterministic classical polynomial-time many-one reductions when nuclear charges are positive binary integers, positions and thresholds are rational, electron count is unary, and the threshold gap is at least inverse input length? Ask for reductions with gap at least one, without auxiliary effective interactions.
